title: Design, synthesis and biological evaluation of some imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivatives as anti-tubercular agents: an in silico - in vitro approach.
authors: Patel, Harnisha; Nagani, Afzal; Patel, Mirav; Patel, Mitesh; Yadav, Mange Ram
one_liner_zh: 该文为咪唑并吡啶类抗结核化合物的设计合成与体外评价，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅网络药理学提及DNA结合转录因子活性，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, we designed, synthesized and evaluated some novel imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivatives as potential anti-TB agents. Preliminary in vitro screening for anti-TB activity of the synthesized compounds was performed against H37Rv strain using the microplate Alamar Blue assay (MABA). Network pharmacology was used to identify the possible targets and pathways of these compounds against Mtb infection. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were also performed to investigate the binding modes and stability of these compounds with the selected targets. The results showed that some of the synthesized compounds (6b, 6c, 6e, 6f, 6h, 6i, 6j, 6n and 6o) exhibited potent anti-TB activity, with minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) ranging from 1.6 to 6.25 mug/mL. The network pharmacology analysis revealed that among the 455 putative targets of imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivatives, 24 targets are the potential targets for treatment of Mtb infection. Among these 24 targets, 10 hub-targets were identified (TLR4, ICAM1, TLR9, STAT3, TNFRSF1A, ERBB2, CXCR3, ACE, IKBKG and NOS2) which were significantly involved in GO processes such as positive regulation of DNA-binding transcription factor activity, peptidyl-tyrosine phosphorylation, positive regulation of inflammatory response, mononuclear cell proliferation, regulation of hemopoiesis and cytokine production involved in inflammatory response and KEGG pathways such as pathways in Tuberculosis, NF-kappa B signalling, HIF-1 signalling PD-L1 expression, and PD-1 checkpoint pathway in cancer. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed the stable interactions of imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivatives with core target active sites, highlighting their potential as novel anti-TB drug candidates.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们设计、合成并评估了一系列新型咪唑并[1,2-a]吡啶衍生物作为潜在抗结核药物。通过微孔板阿尔玛蓝试验（MABA）对合成化合物进行了初步体外抗结核活性筛选，针对H37Rv菌株进行测试。利用网络药理学方法鉴定了这些化合物对抗结核分枝杆菌感染的潜在靶点和通路。同时进行了分子对接和分子动力学模拟，以研究这些化合物与选定靶点的结合模式及稳定性。结果表明，部分合成化合物（6b、6c、6e、6f、6h、6i、6j、6n和6o）表现出强效抗结核活性，最低抑菌浓度（MICs）范围为1.6至6.25微克/毫升。网络药理学分析显示，在咪唑并[1,2-a]吡啶衍生物的455个推定靶点中，有24个是治疗结核分枝杆菌感染的潜在靶点。在这24个靶点中，鉴定出10个核心靶点（TLR4、ICAM1、TLR9、STAT3、TNFRSF1A、ERBB2、CXCR3、ACE、IKBKG和NOS2），这些靶点显著参与基因本体（GO）过程，如DNA结合转录因子活性的正向调控、肽基酪氨酸磷酸化、炎症反应的正向调控、单核细胞增殖、造血调控及炎症反应中细胞因子产生，以及KEGG通路，如结核病通路、NF-κB信号通路、HIF-1信号通路、PD-L1表达及癌症中的PD-1检查点通路。分子对接和动力学模拟证实了咪唑并[1,2-a]吡啶衍生物与核心靶点活性位点的稳定相互作用，突显了其作为新型抗结核药物候选物的潜力。
